info.brief: Functions to generate glyphs for fonts at runtime.
info.description: Functions to generate glyphs for fonts at runtime.

elements.name: fontgen.load_font
elements.description: Creates a mapping between a .fontc file and a .ttf file. Increases the ref count for both resources.

parameters.name: fontc_path
parameters.doc: Path to a .fontc file in the project

parameters.name: ttf_path
parameters.doc: Path to a .ttf file in the project

fields.name: sdf_edge
fields.doc: Where the edge is decided to be [0-255]

parameters.name: complete_function
parameters.doc: function to call when the animation has completed

fields.name: self
fields.doc: The context of the calling script

fields.name: fontc_hash
fields.doc: The path hash of the .fontc resource

elements.name: fontgen.unload_font
elements.description: Removes the generator mapping between the .fontc and .ttf file. Decreases the ref count for both resources. Does not remove the previously generated glyphs!

parameters.name: fontc_path_hash
parameters.doc: Path hash of the .fontc file in the project

elements.name: fontgen.add_glyphs
elements.description: Asynchronoously sdds glyphs to the .fontc resource.

parameters.name: fontc_path_hash
parameters.doc: Path hash of the .fontc file in the project

parameters.name: text
parameters.doc: Utf-8 string containing glyphs to add to the .fontc *Note* No checks for duplicate glyphs is done.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Function to be called after the last glyph was processed. May be nil.

fields.name: result
fields.doc: True if all glyphs were added successfully

fields.name: errmsg
fields.doc: Error string if a glyph wasn't generated or added successfully

returnvalues.doc: Returns a request id, used in the callback

parameters.name: fontc_path_hash
parameters.doc: Path hash of the .fontc file in the project

parameters.name: text
parameters.doc: Utf-8 string containing glyphs to remove from the .fontc
